decision_conditions: The proposed development, by reason of its scale, siting, design, bulk and mass would be an undesirable addition to the existing dwelling. The proposal fails to preserve the existing character of the dwelling and pattern of development. The first floor rear extension and dormer would be a significant addition to the site,  failing to remain within the 45 degree angle as taken from the corner of the neighbouring dwelling, and resulting in the site appearing as overdeveloped. The proposal would result in a staggered roof form with the site appearing as overdeveloped.  As such, the cumulative impact of the proposal would cause undue harm to the character and appearance of the host dwelling and surrounding area. The proposal is therefore contrary to the following policies which seek to ensure that development recognises local character and promotes good design:   - National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, 2024)- Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021)- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012)- Policies SP2, DMD1 and DMD5 of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037: (September 2024)

The proposed development, by reason of its scale, siting and design would cause severe harm to the neighbouring occupiers. Specifically, the proposed development would unacceptably result in a material loss of outlook to the occupiers of No.30 Thorpe Road, and introduce significant levels of overbearing, overshadowing, loss of outlook, and loss of daylight.  The proposed development would therefore constitute unneighbourly development and is contrary to: - National Planning Policy Framework National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (MHCLG, 2024)- Policy D4 of the London Plan (March 2021);- The Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document (February 2012);- Policies SP2, DMD1 and DMD5 of The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham’s Local Plan 2037: (September 2024)
borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
description: Construction of a part two- storey part single storey rear extension and an L- shaped rear dormer extension including three roof lights to the front to facilitate conversion of roof space into habitable accommodation
